plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: Henchman
plugins.Description:
Your personal Henchman doing all the heavy lifting for you!

- A/B Rank Farmer
- Hunt Logs
- Hunt Bills
- Retainer Creation
- Character Creation
- Multi Account Trading
- Multicharacter Ocean Fishing Cycler
- Chocobokeeps
and more to come.
plugins.Changelog:
- **Navigation**
  - Henchman uses MappingTheRealm for cross-zone routes and travel to fixed destinations.

- **On Your Mark**
  - Fixed progress tracking for old weekly hunt bills after the weekly reset.
  - Crosses the Ruby Sea dome entrance only when needed and waits for the transition to finish.
  - Prefers marks already in attack range, checks for landable ground and a short walk to the target, and handles dismount cases that previously timed out.

- **Combat rotation**
  - Improved Wrath IPC recovery. Henchman retries an invalid cached lease once and can fall back to another loaded rotation plugin if Wrath fails to start.
  - Wrath IPC errors now identify the failed operation and include any result code returned by Wrath.

- **Testy Trader**
  - Optionally use MogVault to let the Boss withdraw and store items marked for retainer storage in the trade plan.
  - Checks inventory capacity before trades and supports travel to the destination housing ward.
  - Use the Trade Type header menu to set the trade type for every item in the selected plan.
  - Use the header checkbox to enable or disable every item in the selected plan, including items hidden by filters.

- **Retainer Vocate and interface**
  - Improved retainer name editing and messages when the game rejects a name.
  - Polished Ocean Fishing, Into the Light, and Testy Trader layouts, plus requirement and status displays.
  - Categories remember your feature selection until reload. Release notes can open on update and are available from the plugin icon.

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: Knightshopper
plugins.Punchline: Knightshopping made easy - ShopMore, click less.
plugins.Description:
Your personal shopper who will take care of all your currency spendings!

Knightshopper: because even knights deserve a squire for their shopping.
plugins.Changelog:
- **Navigation and vendor interaction**:
  - Shopping now uses MappingTheRealm for navigation and reachability checks. Install and enable MappingTheRealm and vnavmesh.
  - Improved vendor interaction and added Grand Company Seal shopping that selects vendors for your character.

- **Artisan and MogVault**:
  - Import materials from an Artisan list into Knightshopper shopping lists.
  - Optionally count items in your character's saddlebags and retainers toward **Buy Until** targets using MogVault.

- **Vendor browser and shopping lists**:
  - Browse vendors by currency and subcurrency with icon pickers, prices, purchase quantities, and shop menu paths.
  - The **Add Item** picker stays open while you edit a list. Click a pink entry to remove it, or filter by currency when a shop accepts several.
  - Fixed clipped **Buy** and **Remove** buttons on narrow lists and added scroll indicators to the currency sidebar.

- **Purchase IPC**:
  - Other plugins can request a purchase for one item from a specific vendor without creating a shopping list.
  - Set minimum starting balances for IPC purchases per currency and subcurrency.

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: MogVault
plugins.Punchline: Lost an item? Your moogle knows where, kupo!
plugins.Description:
Remembers what your characters, retainers and free companies hold, so you can look it up from any character.

- Item search across characters, retainers, FC chests, glamour dresser and armoire
- Storage info in the game's item tooltips (optional)
- Jobs, currencies, quests and collections of all characters
- Glamour dresser outfits and armoire per character
- Retainer gil, items and ventures
- FC chest, credits and submarine/airship voyages
- Houses, apartments and private chambers with last entry time
- Hide names for screenshots, daily backups
- IPC for other plugins
plugins.Changelog:
- **First release**:
  - MogVault remembers what your characters own as you play. Look up captured data from any character with `/mogvault`.

- **Item search and storage**:
  - Search inventories, armoury chests, saddlebags, retainers, free company chests, glamour dressers, and armoires.
  - Use `/mogvault find <item name>` from chat or enable item tooltips to see where you keep an item and how many you have.
  - View the vendor sell value of your holdings.

- **Characters, retainers, and collections**:
  - Compare job levels, MSQ and quest progress, gil, currencies, mounts, and minions across characters.
  - Browse glamour dresser outfits and armoire contents. See retainer inventories, gil, and venture timers.

- **Free companies, housing, and voyages**:
  - View FC members, ranks, credits, chest items, and chest gil. Track airship and submersible return times.
  - See tracked houses, apartments, and private chambers with the last recorded entry time.

- **Privacy, backups, and integrations**:
  - Hide names in the UI for screenshots, configure daily local backups, and delete individual records or clear saved data.
  - Other plugins can query saved inventory, character, collection, and timer data through IPC.

plugins.Author: Knightmore
plugins.Name: MappingTheRealm
plugins.Punchline: From here to there, by land, sea, sky, or aetheryte.
plugins.Description: Mapping The Realm plans routes across FFXIV zones, using vnavmesh to find paths within each zone and linking them by walking, flying, ferry, teleport and other movement options. Pick a destination and find the shortest route.
plugins.Changelog:
- **First standalone release**:
  - MappingTheRealm is now a shared navigation plugin powered by vnavmesh. Install both plugins for movement.
  - Route across zones using mounts, flight, Sprint, aetherytes, aethernet, chocobo porters, and other supported transport.

- **Travel, Housing, and Places**:
  - Navigate to a zone, exact coordinates, a map flag in another zone, or a housing ward or plot.
  - Find menders, shop NPCs, and summoning bells in searchable, sortable tables. Shop filters include FATE and inclusion vendors.

- **Address Book and chat commands**:
  - Save a position under your own name and return to it with one click or `/mtr address 1`.
  - Use `/mtr Mist 1 20` to visit a housing plot or `/mtr Shiva` to request an in-game World Visit. Choose Limsa Lominsa, Gridania, or Ul'dah as your preferred departure city.

- **Route details and controls**:
  - Expand route steps to see coordinates, territory IDs, fallback positions, and transport IDs when available. Durations are estimates.
  - See the active step in the floating status display and cancel any MappingTheRealm route, including routes started by other plugins.

- **Plugin integration**:
  - IPC v1 lets other plugins request travel, check reachability, monitor routes, and cancel their own requests. The release includes a drop-in C# IPC client.
